title: The Celebrity Club's drinking house band and the offer to replace it
summary: The owner has a band of alcoholics he is willing to replace, and Tate decides to take the job.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Sol Moore, I don't know what happened to Sol, a hell of an arranger. He had good arrangements and a good band. They'd been there seven years, but they were all alcoholics. Never could get them all on the stand. Every one of them was just -- I mean, terrible alcoholics. So he put up with that for many years. So he says, "I would really like for you to bring a band in here." He says, "I'm going to give them another chance, but, I'm not going to keep giving them chances. Now, you think about that." So I says, "Okay." And, you know, the more I'd think about it, I says, "Now if these cats been here seven years, messing up like this, hell, maybe I can stay ten doing right." You know what I mean?

I was playing down at Savannah Club. So he called me one day, he says, "Are you ready to form your band and come in?" So I says, -- he says, "Come on down and talk money." So I says, "Yeah, I'm ready." So then we was like Thursday through Sundays.
